Professional Summary
AI Engineer with hands-on experience designing and deploying Copilot-driven workflows and Azure OpenAI integrations for enterprise services. Proven track record in building Dataverse-backed solutions and automating business processes using Power Automate. Strong collaboration using Confluence and Jira.

Technical Skills
Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure OpenAI, Dataverse, Confluence, Jira

Work Experience
AI Engineer, Kite Learning (Feb 2025 - Present)
- Designed and deployed Copilot assistants using Microsoft Copilot Studio to support internal learning content generation; integrated Azure OpenAI models to produce contextualized course outlines and sample assessments.
- Implemented Dataverse-backed content metadata store to manage learning assets and enable fast retrieval for Copilot queries, improving asset lookup latency by measurable margins.
- Automated content publishing workflows with Power Automate to route items through review in Confluence and track status in Jira, reducing manual handoffs.
- Tuned prompts and system behavior for Azure OpenAI to minimize hallucinations in generated learning materials and improved relevance for end-user queries.

Copilot Developer, Ola (May 2024 - Jan 2025)
- Built customer support Copilot prototypes in Microsoft Copilot Studio leveraging Azure OpenAI to draft responses and suggest troubleshooting steps based on user context.
- Modeled ride and user conversation data into Dataverse to provide Copilot with structured context for personalized suggestions and escalation decisions.
- Created Power Automate flows to trigger follow-up actions (notifications, ticket creation) from Copilot interactions and synchronized tasks with Jira for engineering handoffs.
- Documented implementation details and runbooks in Confluence and collaborated with cross-functional teams to iterate on Copilot behavior based on real-world usage metrics.
